title: Tsen-Lang theorem for function fields of r-dimensional varieties over algebraically closed fields
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The central task is to construct a nonzero common solution by replacing rational unknowns with global sections of increasing ample powers. Asymptotic Riemann-Roch must compare the growth of the coefficient equations and unknown sections with the sharp inequality n>d^r, reducing the problem to homogeneous intersection over an algebraically closed field.
